> **Key figures**  
> - **Thomas Jefferson** – Principal author of the Declaration.  
> - **John Hancock** – President of the Continental Congress; his large, bold signature is the most recognizable.  
> - **Benjamin Franklin** – One of the most respected statesmen and a key diplomat.  
> - **John Adams** – Future second President of the United States.  

### How the Signing Took Place
- **July 4, 1776** – The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence.  
- **August 2, 1776** – The first signatures were affixed to the original parchment.  
- **August 7, 1776** – The remaining signatures were added.  
- **August 12, 1776** – The final signatures were completed.

The original parchment is now housed in the National Archives in Washington, D.C., and is displayed in the Independence Hall Museum in Philadelphia.
